notes: Evals 1-3 are executed deterministically by run_evals.py (scripts and validator against local fixtures). Eval 4 is a trigger check: the prompt must not activate this skill. Persona prose quality is reviewed by a human.

evals.name: happy-path-local-service
evals.prompt: Here's a new client: http://127.0.0.1:{port}/ . Build search personas for the SEO team.
evals.expected_output: Site profile status ok with 3 pages read and services harvested from JSON-LD and headings; 3 personas (emergency homeowner, planned replacement, property manager); personas.json passes validate_personas.py; each persona's services_matched names a service from the profile.
expectations: profile.pages has 3 entries and a page with page_role 'services'
profile.services contains 'Emergency AC Repair' and 'Comfort Club Maintenance Plan'
profile.organization.name is 'Harbor Comfort Heating & Air' and service_areas include 'Bayport'
off-host links (facebook.com) and privacy page are not fetched
every services_matched entry in sample-personas.json appears in profile.services

evals.name: edge-unreachable-url
evals.prompt: Create personas for https://127.0.0.1:9/ (client site is behind a login right now).
evals.expected_output: Script exits 2 with status 'unreachable' and recorded errors; the skill asks for pasted homepage text or proceeds with low-confidence personas and an assumptions list, never inventing proof points.
expectations: profile.status is 'unreachable' and profile.errors is non-empty
SKILL.md instructs the fallback: ask for homepage text, mark confidence low, list assumptions

evals.name: edge-single-page-site
evals.prompt: Who would search for this business? http://127.0.0.1:{port}/ (it's just a landing page for now)
evals.expected_output: Profile status 'partial' with one page and no invented services; the skill produces 1-2 personas with lowered confidence rather than padding to three.
expectations: profile.services is empty (no services invented from a one-line landing page)
validator rejects sample-personas-bad.json with messages about funnel_stage enum, empty query, duplicate query across buckets, unmatched service and persona_count mismatch

evals.name: should-not-trigger-topical-map
evals.prompt: Build a topical map for a Phoenix HVAC company, we already have their personas.
evals.expected_output: This skill does not run. The request is for a topical map, which is a downstream task; the description's exclusion list names topical maps explicitly.
expectations: SKILL.md description lists topical maps in its 'Do NOT use' clause
